resources.string: Exports the latest finalized WAV and the current log as a ZIP. Capture is enabled under Audio → Dump to file.
No audio capture is available. Recording requires Audio → Dump to file and a normal game stop to finalize the WAV.
The latest WAV is empty or unfinished. A normal game stop is required to finalize recording.
Audio capture can be exported after stopping the game.
ZIP saved with %1$s. It also includes the current log if available.
